They are snared in holes and hid in prison houses
They are sold to the isles
explanation: This is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses.

question: What has the LORD poured upon Israel?
choices: The fury of his anger and the strength of battle
The wine of his wrath only
explanation: He hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle.

question: Why was Jacob given for a spoil?
choices: They would not walk in his ways nor obey his law
explanation: They would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

question: Who are told to sing a new song, besides those who go down to the sea?
explanation: Ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

question: Who shall shout from the top of the mountains?
explanation: Let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

question: What is said of the one who sees many things?
explanation: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

question: What is said of the people who are a prey and a spoil?
choices: The LORD hears them at once
None delivereth and none saith, Restore
explanation: They are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

question: Who is to lift up his voice besides the villages of Kedar?
choices: The wilderness and the cities thereof
explanation: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice.

question: Where are the people to declare the LORD's praise?
explanation: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.

question: What does the LORD say he did to the heavens?
explanation: He that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth.

question: What does the LORD give to the people upon the earth?
explanation: He that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein.

question: When does the LORD tell of new things?
explanation: New things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

question: What do they say to the molten images?
explanation: That say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

question: What did Israel not do, though he was set on fire round about?
explanation: It hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

question: Whom does the LORD call blind and deaf, though he sent him as a messenger?
explanation: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent?

question: From where is the LORD's praise to be sung in the new song?
explanation: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth.

question: Which lands did the LORD give for Israel's ransom?
explanation: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

question: What does the LORD call his people, who are to know and believe him?
explanation: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen.

question: From which two directions will the LORD bring Israel's seed?
explanation: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west.

question: What will the LORD say to the north and to the south?
choices: Give up and Keep not back
explanation: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back.

question: Why does the LORD blot out Israel's transgressions?
choices: For the sake of the temple
explanation: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

question: For whose sake did the LORD send to Babylon?
explanation: For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles.

question: Why did the LORD form this people for himself?
explanation: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

question: Who will honour the LORD because he gives waters in the wilderness?
explanation: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness.

question: To whom will the LORD give drink in the wilderness?
explanation: I give waters in the wilderness, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

question: How has the LORD called Israel?
explanation: I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

question: Why does the LORD say he will give men and people for Israel?
choices: Israel had paid a great price
Israel was precious in his sight and loved
explanation: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee.

question: What were the called by his name created for?
explanation: Every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory.

question: Whom does the LORD tell to be brought forth?
choices: The blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears
explanation: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

question: What does the LORD challenge the nations to bring forth?
explanation: Let all the nations be gathered together: let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified.

question: What does the LORD say about gods before and after him?
choices: None was formed before him, nor shall be after him
explanation: Before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

question: What was not among them when the LORD declared and saved?
explanation: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you.

question: What does the LORD say of anyone who would deliver out of his hand?
choices: None can deliver; who shall let it?
explanation: There is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

question: Whose cry is in the ships?
explanation: I have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

question: What becomes of the chariot, horse, army and power?
choices: They lie down together and are quenched as tow
explanation: They shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

question: What will the LORD make in the desert, with a way in the wilderness?
explanation: I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

question: What has Israel not brought the LORD?
choices: The small cattle of burnt offerings
explanation: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices.

question: What has Israel wearied the LORD with?
explanation: Thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

question: Who has sinned and transgressed against the LORD?
choices: Thy first father and thy teachers
explanation: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

question: What has the LORD done to the princes of the sanctuary?
explanation: I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.

question: What will the LORD give for Israel's life?
explanation: Therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

question: Before what was the LORD he?
explanation: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand.

question: What has Israel not bought the LORD with money?
explanation: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money.

question: With what has Israel not filled the LORD?
explanation: Neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices.

question: What has the LORD not done to Israel regarding offerings?
explanation: I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

question: What has Jacob not done, but been weary of the LORD?
explanation: Thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

question: What does the LORD invite Israel to do?
choices: Offer a lamb at the altar
Put him in remembrance and plead together
explanation: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

question: Which wild creatures honour the LORD?
explanation: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls.

question: How does the LORD call himself in speaking to Israel?
choices: Your Judge, the ruler of Israel, your Lord
Your Rock, the shepherd of Israel, your Father
Your Shield, the helper of Israel, your God
Your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King
explanation: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

question: Whom will the LORD bring from far and from the ends of the earth?
explanation: Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth.

question: Why does the LORD call Israel his witnesses?
choices: That they may fight his wars
That they may judge the nations
That they may build his house
That they may know, believe and understand he is he
explanation: Ye are my witnesses: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he.

question: What three things does the LORD say he has done?
explanation: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed.

question: What does the LORD make in the mighty waters?
explanation: Which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters.

question: What does the LORD say shall not overflow Israel?
explanation: Through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee.

question: Like what will the LORD's chosen spring up by the water courses?
explanation: They shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

question: What does the LORD call Cyrus?
explanation: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure.

question: What does the LORD say to Jerusalem and the temple?
choices: Jerusalem built; the temple's foundation laid
explanation: Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

question: After what figure does the carpenter make the idol?

A lion, according to the strength of a lion
A bull, according to the strength of a bull
A bird, according to the wings of a bird
explanation: He maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man.

question: What does the man pray to his idol made of the residue?

Bless me; for thou art my king
Hear me; for thou art my father
Heal me; for thou art my rock
explanation: He falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

question: Who are called to sing because the LORD hath done it?
choices: The heavens, the earth, the mountains and the forest
The priests, the Levites and the singers
The kings, the princes and the judges
The captives, the poor and the strangers
explanation: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains.

question: What does the LORD say of Israel in his word to Jacob?
choices: Thou shalt not be forgotten of me
explanation: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

question: What does the LORD say about who stretched forth the heavens?
choices: He did it with the sea
explanation: I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone.

question: What does the LORD say to the deep?
explanation: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers.

question: What other name is given to Israel in the LORD's call?
explanation: Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

question: How does the LORD describe himself as the King of Israel?
choices: Judge of Israel and his shield the LORD of Jacob
Father of Israel and his rock the LORD of Zion
Shepherd of Israel and his friend the LORD of heaven
King of Israel and his redeemer the LORD of hosts
explanation: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts.

question: What does the LORD say when he asks, Is there a God beside me?
choices: There are gods of the nations
There is a god in Babylon
There is no God; I know not any
explanation: Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.

question: What is said of those who make a graven image?
choices: They are wise craftsmen of the land
They are blessed by the LORD
They are chosen by the king
They are vanity; their delectable things profit not
explanation: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit.

question: How does the smith work the idol?
choices: With a chisel and a saw
With a plough and a sickle
With a loom and a needle
With the tongs in the coals, and with hammers
explanation: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers.

question: What does the carpenter use to mark out the idol?
choices: A rule, a line, planes and a compass
explanation: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass.

question: Which trees does the man hew down?
choices: Cedars, the cypress and the oak
explanation: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak.

question: What does the man do with part of the tree?

explanation: He will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread.

question: Why can they not see or understand?
choices: They are in a far country
He hath shut their eyes and hearts
explanation: He hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

question: What does the deceived man fail to say?

Is there not a way of escape?
Is there not a lie in my right hand?
explanation: A deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

question: What does the LORD say to Israel after blotting out his transgressions?
choices: Return unto me; for I have redeemed thee
explanation: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

question: What does the LORD do to the tokens of the liars and the diviners?

Gathers the tokens and sends diviners home
Hides the tokens and makes diviners silent
Frustrates the tokens and makes diviners mad
explanation: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad.

question: What does the LORD do to wise men?
choices: Turns them backward and makes their knowledge foolish
explanation: That turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish.

question: What does the LORD confirm and perform?

The law of Moses and the psalms of David
The names of the tribes and the borders of the land
The word of his servant and the counsel of his messengers
explanation: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers.

question: What shall one do with his hand, and surname himself by the name of Israel?
explanation: Another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.

question: What does the man say while warming himself at the fire?

Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire
It is enough, I will rest
Help me, the fire is too hot
explanation: Yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.

question: What will the LORD raise up in the cities of Judah?
explanation: Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof.

question: What does the LORD say to Jerusalem and the cities of Judah?

Thou shalt be inhabited; ye shall be built
Thou shalt be silent; ye shall be sold
Thou shalt be wise; ye shall be rich
explanation: That saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built.

question: Why does the carpenter make the idol after the figure of a man?
choices: That it may walk in the street
That it may remain in the house
That it may guard the gate
That it may be carried to war
explanation: He maketh it after the figure of a man, that it may remain in the house.

question: What happens to the smith who works the idol?
choices: He sings with joy at his work
He is hungry, drinks no water and is faint
He falls asleep at the forge
explanation: He is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

question: What is said of the workmen who make the idols?
explanation: The workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

question: What does the man ask himself about the stock of a tree?
choices: Shall I fall down to it?
explanation: Shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

question: What will the LORD pour upon Israel's offspring?
explanation: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring.

question: What has turned the man aside, so that he cannot deliver his soul?
explanation: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul.

question: Whom does the LORD ask to declare and set in order what is coming?
choices: Who, as I, shall call and declare it
explanation: Who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people?

question: What does the LORD ask Israel about telling them from that time?

Have not I told thee from that time, and declared it?
Have not I given thee the land?
Have not I sent thee a king?
explanation: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it?

question: What does the man do with the residue of the tree?
choices: Makes a god of it, even his graven image
explanation: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it.

question: How does the LORD say he spread abroad the earth?
explanation: That stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself.
